periods.summary: Oreki stands on a tank at the Tokyo Bay first defense line and uses Violet Pane to share her own body's pain over a five-hundred-meter radius, dropping U.S. landing troops into disabling agony. Because the EDY robots have no pain and ignore her technique, she relies on Renren and Ikazuchi to break them while she continues suppressing human soldiers. Her scene shows how Tokyo's defense depends on both adult knights and selected C-rank student knights.

key_events.summary: Uses Violet Pane to halt U.S. infantry, then coordinates with students against EDY robots.
